user.title: Set up Time Capsule
user.description: Open [Devices & services](/config/integrations/dashboard) and look under **Discovered** for your Time Capsule. If it doesn't appear there, you can enter its address manually.

connect.title: Connect to Time Capsule
connect.description: Enter the SSH connection details for your Time Capsule.

reconfigure.title: Change Time Capsule connection
reconfigure.description: Enter the address and SSH credentials for this Time Capsule.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the host and port, and that the device is reachable.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the username and password.
error.device_changed: The SSH identity changed. Check that this address still belongs to your Time Capsule.

abort.already_configured: This Time Capsule is already configured.
abort.not_time_capsule: This AirPort is not a supported Time Capsule model.
abort.cannot_verify_discovery: The discovered address could not be verified against the saved Time Capsule.

init.title: Backup share monitoring
init.description: Check TCP port 445 from Home Assistant. To also open a share for reading, enter its name and separate SMB login. Clear the share and username to use only the port check.

data_description.smb_password: Leave blank to keep the password for an unchanged share and username.

error.invalid_share: Enter the share name only, without a server address or folder path.
error.incomplete_share: Enter a share name, SMB username, and password together, or clear all three entries.

retired_alert_connection.title: Replace SSH Connected in your Time Capsule alerts
retired_alert_connection.description: An automation still uses the retired sensor `{entity_id}`. Edit the automation and select **Backup Volume Mounted** (`{replacement}`) under **Connection and mount sensors**. This also detects when the backup volume is unmounted.

retired_alert_temperature.title: Update a Time Capsule temperature alert
retired_alert_temperature.description: An automation still uses the retired temperature sensor `{entity_id}`. Edit the automation and select **Temperature** (`{replacement}`). Check the threshold because the new sensor can use a different temperature source.
